About “Seijo”

item.title: Single 'Seijo' release
item.description:
“Seijo” was released on September 25, 2026. The music video also premieres on YouTube at 8 p.m. that day.

Listen›

About the music

I titled it “Seijo” (“normal”) and tried to make music with something abnormal in it.

When I started making the track, I vaguely wanted it to feel like a glitch. But when you use glitches and noise deliberately, they can feel planned and calculated. That makes the glitch seem unnatural. A glitch is more interesting when it is, in a sense, unreasonable.
